info.title: POS API
info.description: Our POS API provides endpoints for synchronizing product data, webhooks for receiving orders from digital sales channels in real time and APIs to manage the order lifecycle including preparation updates which are routed directly onwards to all integrated ordering platforms.

oauth2ClientCredentials.description: Obtain an access token using the partner client ID and client secret. Send the returned token with each API request in the Authorization header as a Bearer token.

tags.name: Endpoints
tags.description: Deliverect Endpoints. Use `https://api.staging.deliverect.com` for testing and `https://api.deliverect.com` in production.

tags.name: Webhooks
tags.description: Deliverect Webhooks. Requests are signed with HMAC-SHA256 using a pre-shared secret configured on your integration, so you can verify they came from Deliverect and weren't altered in transit (see HMAC Authentication Guide here).

schema.example: Please provide a JSON format as specified in the API docs

orderId.description: The original _id that was sent to the POS order webhook

receiptId.description: Internal ID assigned by the POS, typically in a human-readable format for printed receipts.

pickupTime.description: Updated pickupTime is in UTC yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ

reason.description: Reason for a status change e.g. 'ITEM OUT OF STOCK'

timeStamp.description: Timestamp when the status was applied

post.description: Pushes products from a POS location to Deliverect, either the full product database or a subset such as items flagged for online sale. This includes each product’s PLU, name, price and other details, as well as configurations and structures such as modifier groups.

parameters.name: previewSync
parameters.description: Returns how many products would be created, updated or deleted, without applying any changes in Deliverect.

parameters.name: forceUpdate
parameters.description: By default, products existing in Deliverect but missing from the sync are deleted. Set to `false` to check whether more than 30% of existing products would be deleted; if so, a warning is returned in the response.

accountId.description: <Glossary>accountId</Glossary> is the unique identifier of the customer account in Deliverect (obtained during onboarding via the [Register POS](https://developers.deliverect.com/v1.1-restaurants/reference/pos_register) webhook)

locationId.description: <Glossary>locationId</Glossary> is the unique identifier of a physical restaurant location, store, or kitchen (obtained during onboarding via the [Register POS](https://developers.deliverect.com/v1.1-restaurants/reference/pos_register) webhook)

price.description: Defined by an integer with 2 decimal digits, e.g. $5.00 is stored as 500.

productType.description: Specifies the product type being inserted: - `1` – **Product**: a 'top level' item on a menu (can also be grouped within a modifier group or bundle) - `2` – **Modifier**: options selectable when ordering a product, typically modifications of the product - `3` – **Modifier Group**: a grouping of modifiers (can also group products) - `4` – **Bundle**: can only contain products offered as part of a 'Meal Deal', which Deliverect will set to zero value (exception: where Overloads are set) See the product types guide for more details.

gtin.description: GTIN (Global Trade Item Number) for product, which could be EAN code

isVariant.description: Indicates a product is a variant. See the variant products guide for more details.

deliveryTax.description: Tax rate for delivery order, integer with 3 decimal digits. See the product configurations guide for more details.

takeawayTax.description: Tax rate for pickup order, integer with 3 decimal digits. See the product configurations guide for more details.

eatInTax.description: Tax rate for Eat-in order, integer with 3 decimal digits. See the product configurations guide for more details.

priceLevels.description: Object containing the `priceLevels.posId` specified on the `priceLevels` array, and the corresponding price. Example: { "UE": 900, "DL": 850, "TA": 825 }. See the price levels guide for more details.

scopes.description: Define surcharges applied to the specific modifier group or bundle. See the overloads guide for more details.

bundlePrice.description: Determines the price for the overload when the grouping is a bundle. See the overloads guide for more details.

price.description: Determines the price for the overload. See the overloads guide for more details.

defaultQuantity.description: Overrides `defaultQuantity` for this specific scope — specify '1' to 'pre-select' the item only within that scope (compatible with only a few channels).

maxFree.description: Overrides `maxFree` for this specific scope — specifies how many sub products can be ordered at zero value within that scope, normal pricing applying after the set limit.

overloads.description: Specifies price variances from the 'base' price dependant on where the option is offered.

posProductId.description: Internal reference ID for the product coming from the POS. Optional use.

posCategoryIds.description: Products should belong to at least one category; each Id listed corresponds to a lookup table which you will provide along with the customer facing category name — see `categories.posCategoryId`.

imageUrl.description: Cloud hosted image URL. See the product images guide for more details.

nameTranslations.description: Object containing name translations. See the translations guide for more information.

productTags.description: e.g. `108` = mustard. See the product tags guide for the full guide.

multiMax.description: sets the maximum quantity orderable of any one item in a group, can also set the maximum quantity of a product to be ordered in a basket

defaultQuantity.description: applicable to modifiers (productType: 2) to 'pre-select' an option

unitType.description: the unit of the serving size amount. unitType: 1 = Weight (in grams), 2 = Volume (in milliliter), 3 = Count (i.e. piece, slice, tablet, capsule, cookie, etc)

countUnitDescription.description: the unit of the quantity amount

nutritionalInfo.description: An object containing the nutritional values for the product, including flat numeric fields expressed in grams (e.g. fat, protein, salt) as well as `servingSize` and `netQuantity`, each an object specifying an `amount`, `unitType`, and `countUnitDescription`. See the nutritional & supplemental info guide for more details.

instructionsForUse.description: Instructions for the use e.g. "Cool before drink." See the nutritional & supplemental info guide for more information.

prepackaged.description: Indicates if the item is prepackaged.

deposit.description: Value of the deposit if applicable.

countryOfOrigin.description: Food business operator country of origin

legalName.description: The legal name of the product

bottleDepositPrice.description: Legacy attribute. For correct format see `supplementalInfo.deposit` and the deposits guide.

visible.description: This specifies if the item is enabled or disabled within a location

subProducts.description: A product can contain additional options — see the modifier groups guide.

kitchenName.description: An optional additional name for the product that will be sent through with the order

stock.description: The current level of stock for this item (relevant in retail accounts)

channelOverrides.description: Allows the `visible` flag to apply differently per channel. See the guide here. Each key represents the ID of a channel (obtained via GET Integrated Channels). For example channel ID `"7"` (Uber Eats) marked as `"visible": false`, while `"12"` (DoorDash) marked as `"visible": true`.

descriptionTranslations.description: Object containing the translations for the descriptions. See the translations guide for more details.

isVariantGroup.description: Indicates the group contains variants. See the variant products guide for more details.

maxFree.description: Specifies how many sub products can be ordered at zero value, normal pricing applying after the set limit.

minUniqueOptions.description: Minimum unique options that can be selected in any one modifier group.

maxUniqueOptions.description: Maximum unique options that can be selected in any one modifier group.

plu.description: A predefined set of zero-priced items applied to an order by Deliverect. See the auto-apply modifiers guide for more details.

sortOrder.description: Defines the order in which an item will appear when auto-applied. See the auto-apply modifiers guide for more details.

caffeine.description: Caffeine content of the beverage, expressed in milligrams (mg).

alcohol.description: Alcohol percentage, sent as an integer in E2 format (the percentage multiplied by 100) so that decimal values can be represented. For example, `1250` represents 12.5% and `475` represents 4.75%.

caloriesRangeHigh.description: Where a range of calories applies to a variable option e.g. a 'Sandwich Deal' where selections are required. To apply this, the format would be: Minimum = `calories`, Maximum = `caloriesRangeHigh`.

isIngredientGroup.description: Indicates the group contains ingredients (e.g. toppings) rather than variants or standard modifiers.

isUpsell.description: Indicates whether this product is an upsell item.

categories.description: This is the lookup table for every product which specifies `posCategoryIds`. It sets the categories which would form a menu when imported, and also provides a reference when products are added to menus in Deliverect.

posId.description: Id for the priceLevel. Value used inside the array `products.priceLevels`

priceLevels.description: See the price levels guide for more information. This is mandatory when using Price Levels, otherwise the Price Level will not work.

schema.description:
When below URLs are returned as response, they will be automatically set in the location settings. {`

For any webhooks not supported, an empty string can be set

`} ```json Example Response { "ordersWebhookURL": "https://integrator.com/ordersWebhookURL", "syncProductsURL": "https://integrator.com/syncProductsURL", "syncTablesURL": "https://integrator.com/syncTablesURL", "syncFloorsURL": "https://integrator.com/syncFloorsURL", "operationsWebhookURL": "https://integrator.com/operationsURL", "storeStatusWebhookURL": "https://integrator.com/storeStatusURL", "taxCalculationWebhookURL": "https://integrator.com/taxCalculationURL" } ```

syncProductsURL.description: Sync products from the POS to Deliverect (see [Sync Products](ref:pos_syncproducts)).

ordersWebhookURL.description: Insert order from Deliverect to the POS (see [Order Notification](ref:kds_order_notification-1)).

syncTablesURL.description: Sync tables from the POS to Deliverect (see [Sync Tables](ref:pos_tables_locationid)).

syncFloorsURL.description: Sync floors from the POS to Deliverect (see [Sync Floors](ref:pos_floors_locationid)).

operationsWebhookURL.description: Sync operational updates for published menus. Activated only by customer request.

storeStatusWebhookURL.description: Sync any status changes made to channels per location. Activated only by customer request.

taxCalculationWebhookURL.description: Sync calculated tax based on a basket amount (see [Tax Calculation](ref:tax-calculation-2)).

requestBody.description: Sent by Deliverect as a JSON payload.

_created.description: Time the order was created in Deliverect, in the format `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSSSSZ`.

_updated.description: Time the order was last updated in Deliverect, in the format `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSSSSZ`.

_id.description: Unique identifier of the order in Deliverect. Please note cancel requests are processed as new orders with `"status": 100` and bearing original order `_id` (see cancellation guide [here](https://developers.deliverect.com/v1.1-restaurants/docs/how-to-handle-cancellations)).

account.description: Unique customer account ID in Deliverect.

channelOrderId.description: The full unique ID from the delivery channel. Together with the `channel` is guaranteed to be unique for 48h after pickup.

channelOrderDisplayId.description: Alternative order ID set by ordering channel, primarily for convenience and readability. This is not unique and typically a shortened version of `channelOrderId` consisting of 4-5 alphanumeric characters, although may go up to 12 characters.

posReceiptId.description: Provided by the POS in response to incoming orders as a reference to a specific POS receipt.

posLocationId.description: <Glossary>posLocationId</Glossary> is an identifier of the location known on the POS side, it is stored within the POS config in Deliverect.

location.description: <Glossary>locationId</Glossary> is the unique ID for the POS to identify the store location.

channelLink.description: <Glossary>channelLinkId</Glossary> is the unique identifier of the channel (merchant store) in Deliverect. Retrieve all IDs per account via [GET Channel Links](https://developers.deliverect.com/v1.1-restaurants/reference/channel-integrators).

status.description: Current order status (see all Order statuses here).

statusHistory.description: All status changes of the order up to the point the webhook is sent.

timeStamp.description: Time of the status change, in the format `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSSSSZ`.

status.description: Order status (see all Order statuses here).

response.description: In case of error, it will be populated here.

source.description: Source of status update `1` = POS, `2` = Channel and `5` = Internal.

includeCutlery.description: Specifies if cutlery/utensils should be included or not.

by.description: Order source (if known) e.g. `app` or `mobile`, not the same as `channel` that specifies the ordering platform (see guide [here](https://developers.deliverect.com/v1.1-restaurants/docs/how-to-recieve-orders)).

orderType.description:
Type of order.

- Pickup: `1`
- Delivery: `2`
- Eat in: `3`
- Curbside: `4`
- Drive thru: `5`

channel.description: Unique ID of the channel (see [GET Integrated channels](https://developers.deliverect.com/v1.1-restaurants/reference/channel-integrators)).

rating.description: Legacy attribute, not to be referenced as part of an integration.

pickupTime.description: Time the order is due to be picked up, in the format `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSSSSZ`.

deliveryTime.description: Time the order is due to be delivered, in the format `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSSSSZ`.

deliveryIsAsap.description: Signifies if the order is required as soon as possible.

deliveryBy.description: Name of the party fulfilling the delivery.

courierUpdateHistory.description: History of every courier update received for the order.

status.description: Courier status (see all Courier statuses here).

received.description: Time the courier update was received, in the format `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSSSSZ`.

arrivalTime.description: Courier arrival time, in the format `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSSSSZ`.

deliveryTime.description: Courier delivery time, in the format `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSSSSZ`.

source.description: The source from where the update is coming: `1` = POS, `2` = Channel, `3` = DMA, `4` = Driver, `5` = Internal, `6` = Delivery System, `7` = Manual, `8` = KDS, `9` = Bill to Order Status.

phoneAccessCode.description: Phone access code used to contact channel support (e.g. `1123`).

note.description: Note from the customer (e.g. "Call once you arrive").

street.description: This includes the street number where provided, e.g. `Stationsstraat 79e`.

source.description: Sent to the POS where address information exists, to help handle address variations from different countries.

orderIsAlreadyPaid.description: Statement of whether an order was paid online or not.

taxes.description: All taxes applied to an order (in tax exclusive regions only).

total.description: The composite total of all taxes. It will be sent as an integer with 2 decimal digits e.g. 1 euro would be sent as 100.

amount.description: Total amount tendered. It will be sent as an integer with 2 decimal digits e.g. 1 euro would be sent as 100.

due.description: Any outstanding amount to be collected from the customer if there is a cash (unpaid) order. It will be sent as an integer with 2 decimal digits e.g. 1 euro would be sent as 100.

rebate.description: Any discounts offered by the channel. The ordering customer pays the amount without the rebate, but the restaurant receives the total amount from the channel. It will be sent as an integer with 2 decimal digits e.g. 1 euro would be sent as 100.

commissionType.description: The type of commission rate charged, as categorised by the channel.

items.description: All the items included in an order.

_id.description: Unique identifier of the item line within the order.

name.description: The name of the product or modifier.

sortOrder.description: The 'stepped' order of any auto-applied items, where `0` is the first item to be listed (see guide [here](https://developers.deliverect.com/page/product-configuration#auto-apply)).

price.description: Price set for the product or modifier. It will be sent as an integer with 2 decimal digits e.g. 1 euro would be sent as 100.

quantity.description: Quantity of item ordered, for subItems quantity, see guide [here](https://developers.deliverect.com/docs/how-to-interpret-modifiers-and-the-quantity-ordered).

productType.description: Specific type of item (see full list [here](https://developers.deliverect.com/reference/insertupdate-products-and-categories#product-types)).

remark.description: A note specific to an individual item.

isCombo.description: Indicates a product sold is part of a combo.

inBundle.description: Indicates the item is contained inside a bundle.

categoryInfo.description: Category metadata for the item, where available.

subItems.description: All subitems are items associated with the product ordered. The quantity is multiplied by however many top-level items are ordered (see guide [here](https://developers.deliverect.com/docs/how-to-interpret-modifiers-and-the-quantity-ordered)).

_id.description: Unique identifier of the item line within the order.

name.description: The name of the product or modifier.

sortOrder.description: The 'stepped' order of any auto-applied items, where `0` is the first item to be listed (see guide [here](https://developers.deliverect.com/page/product-configuration#auto-apply)).

price.description: Price set for the product or modifier. It will be sent as an integer with 2 decimal digits e.g. 1 euro would be sent as 100.

quantity.description: Quantity of item ordered, for subItems quantity, see guide [here](https://developers.deliverect.com/docs/how-to-interpret-modifiers-and-the-quantity-ordered).

productType.description: Specific type of item (see full list [here](https://developers.deliverect.com/reference/insertupdate-products-and-categories#product-types)).

remark.description: A note specific to an individual item.

isCombo.description: Indicates a product sold is part of a combo.

inBundle.description: Indicates the item is contained inside a bundle.

categoryInfo.description: Category metadata for the item, where available.

subItems.description: Nested sub-items, following the same structure.

count.description: Number of packages used for the item.
Number of packages used for the item.

discountReferenceIds.description: An array of identifiers for each discount applied to an item (see guide [here](https://developers.deliverect.com/docs/how-are-discounts-sent)).

decimalDigits.description: Decimal precision of order and payment amounts.

numberOfCustomers.description: Indicates how many diners (applicable to table ordering).

channelOrderRawId.description: Deliverect internal ID of an order.

channelOrderHistoryRawIds.description: Legacy attribute, not to be referenced as part of an integration.

serviceCharge.description: Service charge applied. It will be sent as an integer with 2 decimal digits e.g. 1 euro would be sent as 100.

deliveryCost.description: Delivery cost applied. It will be sent as an integer with 2 decimal digits e.g. 1 euro would be sent as 100.

bagFee.description: A surcharge applied for the packaging. It will be sent as an integer with 2 decimal digits e.g. 1 euro would be sent as 100.

tip.description: A tip intended for the restaurant operator. It will be sent as an integer with 2 decimal digits e.g. 1 euro would be sent as 100.

driverTip.description: A tip intended for the driver/courier. It will be sent as an integer with 2 decimal digits e.g. 1 euro would be sent as 100.

smallOrderFee.description: A surcharge applied by channels who impose minimum basket fees. It will be sent as an integer with 2 decimal digits e.g. 1 euro would be sent as 100.

discountTotal.description: Ordering platforms may offer multiple forms of discount e.g. % discount. A discount total is sent as a minus value representing the deduction from the total order (see guide [here](https://developers.deliverect.com/docs/how-are-discounts-sent)). It will be sent as an integer with 2 decimal digits e.g. 1 euro would be sent as 100.

discounts.description: All applied discounts within an order. This array may be empty, as not all channels share detailed discount information (see more info [here](https://developers.deliverect.com/v1.1-restaurants/docs/how-to-handle-discounts#additional-discount-details)).

type.description: Mapped channel discount type from the [list of Discount Types in Deliverect](https://developers.deliverect.com/page/list-of-discount-types).

provider.description: The issuer of the discount, i.e. the one who bears the discounted amount (see [list of provider types in Deliverect](https://developers.deliverect.com/page/discount-provider-type)).

channelDiscountCode.description: The unique discount code used by the channel.

referenceId.description: A unique identifier of the discount, where applicable, this will show against items included in the discount.

value.description: The flat amount of money or percentage covered by the discount, stored with precision 2, so $1.50 -> `150`, 25.1% -> `2510`.

amount.description: Actual amount discounted, e.g. 10% off on a $50 bill, the `value` will be `1000` and `amount` will be `500`. It will be sent as an integer with 2 decimal digits e.g. 1 euro would be sent as 100.

amountRestaurant.description: The amount of the restaurant's contribution to the discount. It will be sent as an integer with 2 decimal digits e.g. 1 euro would be sent as 100.

amountChannel.description: The amount of the channel's contribution to the discount. It will be sent as an integer with 2 decimal digits e.g. 1 euro would be sent as 100.

capacityUsages.description: Legacy attribute, not to be referenced as part of an integration.

recent.description: Legacy attribute, not to be referenced as part of an integration.

resolvedBy.description: Legacy attribute, not to be referenced as part of an integration.

brandId.description: Appears where the customer operates multiple brands from one location (see [Get account brands](https://developers.deliverect.com/reference/get-accounts-brands)).

testOrder.description: Only applicable as `true` in staging environment via menu preview orders.

timezone.description: Timezone of the location, e.g. `Europe/London` (see TZ [list here](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_tz_database_time_zones)).

tags.description: Custom tag(s) applied to the store location, typically a brand name, e.g. `["Best Burger"]`.

taxTotal.description: Sum of `deliveryTax` + `serviceChargeTax` + `deliveryCostTax`. It will be sent as an integer with 2 decimal digits e.g. 1 euro would be sent as 100.

taxRemitted.description: Some ordering platforms collect and pay taxes and share this info as a value-remitted tax. It will be sent as an integer with 2 decimal digits e.g. 1 euro would be sent as 100.

table.description: With 'Eat-in' orders (`"orderType": 3`) a table identifier can be sent (see more details [here](https://developers.deliverect.com/page/pos-direct-table-ordering)).

schema.description: Please note any Deprecated parameters should be ignored

200.description: Return a `2xx` status to confirm receipt, then send status updates asynchronously via [Update Order Status](https://developers.deliverect.com/v1.1-restaurants/reference/update-order-status).

schema.description:
The body is the standard Order Notification payload with two additional top-level fields, `validationId` and `callbackUrl`. Prices and amounts are integer values in the smallest currency unit (cents).

Please note any Deprecated parameters should be ignored

200.description: Synchronous validation ([flow diagram](https://developers.deliverect.com/page/synchronous-order-validation)). Recommended where possible, so validation errors reach the guest straight away.

schema.description:
Return the validation result. When you know the failure mode, return explicit `errors[]` entries with the correct `code` ([see list of error codes](https://developers.deliverect.com/page/validation-error-codes)); otherwise Deliverect infers errors from a minimal response. Rules are applied in order:

| Rule | Applies when your response includes | Deliverect's result |
|---|---|---|
| **Explicit errors** | Entries in `errors[]` | Errors take precedence, so never set `isValid: true` while also reporting errors. |
| **Partial stock** | `items[]` with `available: false` and `quantity` > `0` but below the requested quantity | `quantity_unavailable` |
| **Full unavailability** | `items[]` with `available: false` and `quantity` of `0` or omitted | `product_snoozed` |
| **Price comparison** | `items[].price` | Compared to the matching request line (by `itemId`, then `plu`). A difference over 1 cent returns `price_mismatch`. |
| **Tax comparison** | `charges.tax` or `taxTotal` | Compared to the request's `taxTotal`. A difference over 1 cent returns `tax_mismatch`. |
| **De-duplication** | Identical `(code, path)` pairs | Returned once only. |

items.description: Per-line POS view of the cart. Used for inferred validation when `errors` is empty.

itemId.description: Deliverect line `_id` from the request. Preferred over `plu` when disambiguating duplicate PLUs.

available.description: `false` if the item cannot be fulfilled as requested.

price.description: POS unit price in smallest currency unit. Compared against the request when no explicit price error is given.

quantity.description: Quantity the POS can fulfil. Used with `available: false` to distinguish partial stock from a full 86.

errors.description: Explicit validation problems. Preferred when you know exactly what failed. Identical `(code, path)` pairs are deduplicated.

code.description:
Machine-readable error code.

| Code | When to use |
|---|---|
| `product_not_found` | PLU does not exist or is not sold at this location. |
| `product_snoozed` | Product exists but is temporarily unavailable (86 / snooze). Also inferred when `available: false` and available quantity is `0` or omitted. |
| `quantity_unavailable` | Requested quantity exceeds available stock. Inferred when `available: false` and `quantity` is greater than `0` but less than requested. |
| `price_mismatch` | POS unit price differs from the request by more than **1 cent**. Inferred when `items[].price` is returned without an explicit error. |
| `tax_mismatch` | POS order tax differs from `taxTotal` / `charges.tax` by more than **1 cent**. Inferred when totals are returned without an explicit error. |
| `unknown` | Any other validation failure, or an unrecognized code string. |

path.description: JSON pointer into the request order, e.g. `/items/0/price` or `/items/1/subItems/0`. Resolved automatically when omitted if `plu` or `itemId` is provided.

expected.description: Value Deliverect sent (e.g. requested quantity or price).

charges.description: Order-level totals as seen by the POS.

subTotal.description: Subtotal excl. tax, smallest currency unit.

202.description: Asynchronous validation ([flow diagram](https://developers.deliverect.com/page/aysynchronous-order-validation)). Return `202` or an empty `200`, then POST the result to `callbackUrl` (see [Validation Response Async](https://developers.deliverect.com/v1.1-restaurants/reference/validation-response-async)).

schema.description:
Use this flow when validation requires a round trip to in-store systems and cannot complete within a few seconds.

15-minute validation window
Deliverect stores pending validations for 15 minutes When responding with a 202 (or an empty 200), the completed result must be posted to the provided callbackUrl within this window. After expiry the validationId is unknown and the callback will return a 400

See [Validation Response Async](https://developers.deliverect.com/v1.1-restaurants/reference/validation-response-async) for the full endpoint reference.

400.description: Client error (any `4xx` is treated as a failed validation)

reason.description: Reason for the failure, surfaced to the channel as a failed validation.

500.description: Internal server error (any `5xx` is treated as a failed validation)

reason.description: Reason for the failure, surfaced to the channel as a failed validation.

taxes.description: All taxes applied to an order (in tax exclusive regions only).

total.description: The composite total of all taxes. It will be sent as an integer with 2 decimal digits e.g. 1 euro would be sent as 100.

amount.description: Total amount tendered. It will be sent as an integer with 2 decimal digits e.g. 1 euro would be sent as 100.

due.description: Any outstanding amount to be collected from the customer if there is a cash (unpaid) order. It will be sent as an integer with 2 decimal digits e.g. 1 euro would be sent as 100.

rebate.description: Any discounts offered by the channel. The ordering customer pays the amount without the rebate, but the restaurant receives the total amount from the channel. It will be sent as an integer with 2 decimal digits e.g. 1 euro would be sent as 100.

commissionType.description: The type of commission rate charged, as categorised by the channel.

items.description: All the items included in an order.

_id.description: Unique identifier of the item line within the order.

name.description: The name of the product or modifier.

sortOrder.description: The 'stepped' order of any auto-applied items, where `0` is the first item to be listed (see guide [here](https://developers.deliverect.com/page/product-configuration#auto-apply)).

price.description: Price set for the product or modifier. It will be sent as an integer with 2 decimal digits e.g. 1 euro would be sent as 100.

quantity.description: Quantity of item ordered, for subItems quantity, see guide [here](https://developers.deliverect.com/docs/how-to-interpret-modifiers-and-the-quantity-ordered).

productType.description: Specific type of item (see full list [here](https://developers.deliverect.com/reference/insertupdate-products-and-categories#product-types)).

remark.description: A note specific to an individual item.

isCombo.description: Indicates a product sold is part of a combo.

inBundle.description: Indicates the item is contained inside a bundle.

categoryInfo.description: Category metadata for the item, where available.

subItems.description: All subitems are items associated with the product ordered. The quantity is multiplied by however many top-level items are ordered (see guide [here](https://developers.deliverect.com/docs/how-to-interpret-modifiers-and-the-quantity-ordered)).

_id.description: Unique identifier of the item line within the order.

name.description: The name of the product or modifier.

sortOrder.description: The 'stepped' order of any auto-applied items, where `0` is the first item to be listed (see guide [here](https://developers.deliverect.com/page/product-configuration#auto-apply)).

price.description: Price set for the product or modifier. It will be sent as an integer with 2 decimal digits e.g. 1 euro would be sent as 100.

quantity.description: Quantity of item ordered, for subItems quantity, see guide [here](https://developers.deliverect.com/docs/how-to-interpret-modifiers-and-the-quantity-ordered).

productType.description: Specific type of item (see full list [here](https://developers.deliverect.com/reference/insertupdate-products-and-categories#product-types)).

remark.description: A note specific to an individual item.

isCombo.description: Indicates a product sold is part of a combo.

inBundle.description: Indicates the item is contained inside a bundle.

categoryInfo.description: Category metadata for the item, where available.

subItems.description: Nested sub-items, following the same structure.

count.description: Number of packages used for the item.
Number of packages used for the item.

discountReferenceIds.description: An array of identifiers for each discount applied to an item (see guide [here](https://developers.deliverect.com/docs/how-are-discounts-sent)).

decimalDigits.description: Decimal precision of order and payment amounts.

numberOfCustomers.description: Indicates how many diners (applicable to table ordering).

channelOrderRawId.description: Deliverect internal ID of an order.

channelOrderHistoryRawIds.description: Legacy attribute, not to be referenced as part of an integration.

serviceCharge.description: Service charge applied. It will be sent as an integer with 2 decimal digits e.g. 1 euro would be sent as 100.

deliveryCost.description: Delivery cost applied. It will be sent as an integer with 2 decimal digits e.g. 1 euro would be sent as 100.

bagFee.description: A surcharge applied for the packaging. It will be sent as an integer with 2 decimal digits e.g. 1 euro would be sent as 100.

tip.description: A tip intended for the restaurant operator. It will be sent as an integer with 2 decimal digits e.g. 1 euro would be sent as 100.

driverTip.description: A tip intended for the driver/courier. It will be sent as an integer with 2 decimal digits e.g. 1 euro would be sent as 100.

smallOrderFee.description: A surcharge applied by channels who impose minimum basket fees. It will be sent as an integer with 2 decimal digits e.g. 1 euro would be sent as 100.

discountTotal.description: Ordering platforms may offer multiple forms of discount e.g. % discount. A discount total is sent as a minus value representing the deduction from the total order (see guide [here](https://developers.deliverect.com/docs/how-are-discounts-sent)). It will be sent as an integer with 2 decimal digits e.g. 1 euro would be sent as 100.

discounts.description: All applied discounts within an order.

type.description: Mapped channel discount type from the [list of Discount Types in Deliverect](https://developers.deliverect.com/page/list-of-discount-types).

provider.description: The issuer of the discount, i.e. the one who bears the discounted amount (see [list of provider types in Deliverect](https://developers.deliverect.com/page/discount-provider-type)).

channelDiscountCode.description: The unique discount code used by the channel.

referenceId.description: A unique identifier of the discount, where applicable, this will show against items included in the discount.

value.description: The flat amount of money or percentage covered by the discount, stored with precision 2, so $1.50 -> `150`, 25.1% -> `2510`.

amount.description: Actual amount discounted, e.g. 10% off on a $50 bill, the `value` will be `1000` and `amount` will be `500`. It will be sent as an integer with 2 decimal digits e.g. 1 euro would be sent as 100.

amountRestaurant.description: The amount of the restaurant's contribution to the discount. It will be sent as an integer with 2 decimal digits e.g. 1 euro would be sent as 100.

amountChannel.description: The amount of the channel's contribution to the discount. It will be sent as an integer with 2 decimal digits e.g. 1 euro would be sent as 100.

capacityUsages.description: Legacy attribute, not to be referenced as part of an integration.

recent.description: Legacy attribute, not to be referenced as part of an integration.

resolvedBy.description: Legacy attribute, not to be referenced as part of an integration.

brandId.description: Appears where the customer operates multiple brands from one location (see [Get account brands](https://developers.deliverect.com/reference/get-accounts-brands)).

testOrder.description: Only applicable as `true` in staging environment via menu preview orders.

timezone.description: Timezone of the location, e.g. `Europe/London` (see TZ [list here](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_tz_database_time_zones)).

tags.description: Custom tag(s) applied to the store location, typically a brand name, e.g. `["Best Burger"]`.

taxTotal.description: Sum of `deliveryTax` + `serviceChargeTax` + `deliveryCostTax`. It will be sent as an integer with 2 decimal digits e.g. 1 euro would be sent as 100.

taxRemitted.description: Some ordering platforms collect and pay taxes and share this info as a value-remitted tax. It will be sent as an integer with 2 decimal digits e.g. 1 euro would be sent as 100.

table.description: With 'Eat-in' orders (`"orderType": 3`) a table identifier can be sent (see more details [here](https://developers.deliverect.com/page/pos-direct-table-ordering)).

schema.description: Please note any Deprecated parameters should be ignored

taxes.description: Each entry represents a tax applied to the ordered items.

name.description: Human-readable name of the applied tax.

taxClassId.description: Unique identifier for the tax in the POS system.

total.description: Amount of tax payable for the specified tax, expressed as an integer with 2 decimal digits e.g. 1 dollar would be sent as 100.
